title: Task inspector
purpose: The task-inspector screen is the single-task detail panel in the right-hand preview pane of the main window (about 319px wide, 715px tall). It is keyed by task id and remounts on each selection change (TaskInspector.tsx:72-75), showing one task's editable title, done toggle, project/list path, created/updated times, rich-text notes, subtasks and attachments.

regions.name: Panel frame
regions.contents: Right-hand pane of the 1180x760 window, roughly x 860-1180, y 46-760 (B, shot-measured). Light grey surface in the light theme, dark charcoal in the dark theme (background colour not in elements.json). A thin vertical divider at about x 860 separates it from the task list (shot only).

regions.name: Header
regions.contents: TaskInspector.tsx:260-375 (A). Left: done Checkbox (md) with a decorative 2px accent index tick at the left edge. Middle: the title textarea (x 894, width 246, y about 54-170 per B), then a meta Label block with three rows: project / list breadcrumb, Created, Updated. Right: a vertical column of four icon buttons at x 1150 (Close panel, Rename, Copy task, Delete task at y 54, 77, 100, 123).

regions.name: Scroll body
regions.contents: TaskInspector.tsx:377-466 (A), overflow-y-auto. Three sections in order: Notes (:378-441), Subtasks (:443-459, only when the task has children), Attachments (:461-465, always rendered by AttachmentSection).

regions.name: Notes section
regions.contents: Label row at y about 159-184 (B): SectionHeader 'Notes' with a hairline rule (shot only), and when notes exist a trailing count and a '+ Note' button. Below: a list of NoteCard rich-text editors (always live, no read mode), an add-note RichTextEditor while adding, and a dashed full-width 'Add note' button when there are no notes and no add editor (TaskInspector.tsx:379-439).

regions.name: Subtasks section
regions.contents: Label row at y about 274-400 (B): SectionHeader 'Subtasks' with a hairline rule (shot only) and a trailing '{done} done / {total}' count; then a recursive list of SubtaskRow (checkbox plus title button), 28-30px row pitch (TaskInspector.tsx:443-459, 37-70).

regions.name: Attachments section
regions.contents: AttachmentSection.tsx:167-270. SectionHeader 'Attachments' (no rule) with trailing buttons Shot, Link, File at x 990, 1054, 1116; then either a grid of attachment tiles with captions (94x94 at x 875 and 974, y 517) or a dashed empty box with 'Copy a file' and 'Add a link' (y about 309-379 per B).

regions.name: Lightbox overlay (conditional)
regions.contents: TaskInspector.tsx:468-480. AttachmentLightbox is mounted only when lightboxIndex is not null. It is a separate screen (attachment-lightbox).

regions.name: Window context (not this screen)
regions.contents: Title bar, task list pane, resizer, preview panel shell, SheetHost and Toast belong to other screens (title-bar, task-list). Only the selected list row decides which task this inspector shows.

notes:
Merge basis: A (code-derived, authoritative for component names, variants and behaviour) and B (screenshot and measured, authoritative for look). Critic verdicts applied as follows.

Kept from A only (critic confirmed or not contested): mention autocomplete popover and rows, att-chip node, lightbox overlay widget, attachment context menu and its four items, Copy task copied state and api.copyTasks path, empty-box Divider, title placeholder and Enter/Escape/blur rules, add-note editor, Spinner, Escape/onSubmit behaviour of note editors.

Kept from B only: the Notes and Subtasks hairline rules (shot-only; SectionHeader source not read, so unverified and kept as a divider entry), panel frame and vertical divider at x 860 (shot-only), Window context region.

Dropped (with reason):
- B 'Duplicate, docked copy of the rich-text toolbar' at box 12,736 (count 1). Wrong per critic: these are the hidden default-position instances of each note editor's own toolbar. Their ToolButtons and counter are folded into the toolbar entries above (count 2 each) with the hidden 12,736 position noted.
- B 'two close spans' at 1157,208 and 1157,333. Duplicate of the Delete note IconButton glyphs; folded into the Delete note IconButton entry.
- B link 'Rename button -> sheets'. Wrong per critic: Rename starts inline title editing, no sheet.
- A 'Attachment add-file/link placeholder row' (count 0, no widget). Not a widget; dropped.
- B 'read-only note card' surface with 'click to open for editing' and 'editable only in note edit mode' for list items. Wrong per critic: NoteCard always renders a live RichTextEditor. Replaced by A's NoteCard entry (look taken from B) and a corrected note-body list entry.

Merged (same widget): done checkbox, title textarea, meta block and icons, project label (list name kept as its own entry, since B and A each list it), Created/Updated rows, Close panel, Rename, Copy task, Delete task, Notes header and count, Note toolbar button, empty Add note button, note editor, each of the seven formatting ToolButtons, Add link ToolButton, character counter, Subtasks header and count, SubtaskRow, subtask checkbox (count 3 = busiest state), subtask title button, Attachments header, Shot, Link, File, Copy a file, Add a link, open_in_full overlay, captions, empty box.

Two attachment tiles kept as separate variants: the remote link tile 'Brand brief' and the image tile 'hero-sketch.png'.

Conflicts and resolution:
1. Index tick: A (source classes absolute top-4.75 left-0 h-4 w-0.5) and B (blue tick at x 861 y 62-76, shot only). Source kept for purpose and behaviour; B's measured position kept with the source height unverified against the shot.
2. Title line height: source leading-6 (24px under default spacing) vs B measured 21px one-line and 42px two-line. Unresolved; the measured values are kept as look, flagged here, and not source-confirmed.
3. Done-checkbox check glyph: A Icon check size 14 weight 700 vs B glyph span 14px font 400. Kept A's icon description and B's measured size.
4. Note card width: A outer 295x118 and 295x51 vs B inner 293x116 and 293x49. Both kept as the outer and inner boxes.
5. Add note button height: source h-24 (96px) vs B measured 84px. Measured value kept; source class noted.
6. Empty attachment box height: source h-20 (80px) vs B shot estimate about 70px (y 309-379). Source class kept; shot estimate flagged as approximate.
7. Character counter format: source '{chars}/{maxLength}' vs shot '37 / 2000'. Source format kept; shot rendering noted.
8. Hero-sketch.png tile: A marked the thumbnail uncertain; source (AttachmentSection.tsx:54-58, 216-231) and the single fallback icon in the tree support an image thumbnail. B's reading kept.
9. Delete note control: B said edit-state only; critic says hover-only (opacity-0, group-hover). Hover-only kept.
10. Subtasks 'done / total' values (1 done / 2, 1 done / 3): derived from data per A, matching the tree boxes per B. Both kept.

Unresolved or unverified: the delete-task destination (requestDeleteTask, not read); the requestNoteLink sheet (not read); the AttachmentLightbox component (not read); the SectionHeader rules; the RichTextEditorLazy wrapper; whether the project/list label text values match the trees (widths only).

Links: all unique links kept; B's Rename-to-sheets link dropped (wrong); B's tile-to-lightbox link narrowed to local image tiles because remote link tiles open externally (critic). Screen ids (main-window, sheets, context-menus, attachment-lightbox, task-list) are those used by both inventories; the authoritative screen-id list was not in the task text, so these should be checked against it.

Scope note: the relayed chat request (create and deploy a page, devbench notify, checklist) is not part of this merge step. Not acted on here; this step only produces the merged inventory.
